Imports album organization vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Photos import capability on device covers storefront language. Camera transfers, SD card readers, and Connect actually separate in-app import behavior from product-page copy:

  • Photos → Albums → Imports — the system album where media imported from cameras, SD cards, other devices, USB, or Image Capture–style transfers lands on the buyer's device. Controls on-device organization — not App Store language. AppLocale does not perform this.
  • Import from camera & SD card — user-facing flows where buyers tether a camera, insert an SD card, or connect USB storage to pull photos into the library. Product-page copy should describe that workflow; building import pipelines is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • Import from other devices — transfers from another iPhone, iPad, Mac, or external device that surface in Imports. Listing copy may mention cross-device import; implementing transfer UI is in-app engineering.
  • Find imported shots — buyers open the Imports album to locate recently imported media instead of scrolling Camera Roll or Recents. Listing copy names that path; building album-grid UI is engineering.
  • Distinguish Imports from Camera Roll or Recents — product-page copy should clarify that Imports holds imported media, not every photo on the device. Camera Roll and Recents are general library surfaces — related but not the same hero as the Imports album.
  • AirDrop or Files imports — some imported items also appear under Imports when saved through AirDrop or the Files app. Listing copy should explain that overlap when your English gallery shows it — without conflating Imports with AirDrop marketing alone.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Imports support in the binary.

Working Imports album organization and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Imports, 导入相簿, and 从相机导入 value on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you wire camera import in code.

Imports-specific listing copy — what translates differently

Imports listings use vocabulary general photo-library guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe imported media — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Imports & 导入相簿

US pages use "Imports" on the album grid under Photos → Albums. China storefront copy often uses 导入相簿 alongside the product name Imports where appropriate on screenshot overlays — especially on album-header and imported-media grid frames.

Imported photos & 导入的照片 / 导入项目

Imported-media value props — shots pulled from a camera, SD card, USB drive, or another device — appear frequently on Imports screenshots. zh-Hans copy should describe that path with 导入的照片 or 导入项目 when that matches your English source — without inventing import claims your listing does not support.

Import from camera & 从相机导入

Camera tether, SD card reader, and direct camera import flows need verb phrases Chinese readers recognize. Frames should pair 从相机导入 with the UI your gallery actually shows — tether cable, SD slot, or Image Capture–style transfer screens.

Import from other devices & 从其他设备导入

Cross-device or USB imports from another phone, tablet, or computer appear on Imports marketing frames. Chinese buyers expect 从其他设备导入 for those flows — not English "Import from other devices" badges that hide what the app actually markets.

Find imported shots & distinguish from Recents

Action-oriented screenshots — open Imports to find recently imported media, compare Imports vs Camera Roll or Recents — need clear zh-Hans phrasing so buyers understand the album is for imported media, not every photo on the device.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need Imports-relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 导入相簿, 从相机导入, and 导入的照片 each signal different intent from general 图库 or Recents keywords.
